# @sharadox/internationalization-web-library

> One locale configuration → every i18n helper for Next.js App Router sites with /[locale] routes.

- `defineLocales({ locales: ["en","pt"], defaultLocale: "en", cookie?: "locale", languageTags?: { pt: "pt-PT" }, openGraphLocales? })` from `/locale` → { locales, defaultLocale, cookie, isLocale(value), languageTag(locale), openGraphLocale(locale), staticParams(), localePath(locale, path?), alternates(path?) }
- `translate({ en, pt }, locale)` from `/translate`
- `localeRedirects(LOCALES)` from `/locale-redirect` → next.config redirects for "/": cookie → Accept-Language → default (permanent: false)
- `rememberLocale(locale, cookie?)` from `/locale-preference` (cookie, 1 year)
- `<LocaleLink locale current cookie className>` from `/locale-link` ("use client", next/link, remembers choice)
- Types: Translated<Locale>, LocaleOptions, Locales from `/locale/type`
- Peer deps: next, react. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- /locale-redirect localeRedirects(LOCALES) redirects "/" and every path without a locale (except _next, _vercel, api, icon, apple-icon and files with an extension) to the remembered → browser → default locale; pathWithoutLocale(locales) is the path pattern
